body:
I woke up after some restless sleep, and decided I wanted some amps so I insufflated 75 mgs of adderall IR and ate 40 mgs of focalin.
1hr: feeling amazing synergy with focalin in hand too, great feelings of euphoria and getting into deep thought, incredible focus, I feel like an orgasm it's amazing
2 1/2hr: a little bit of an uneven heart beat but it feel good (weird) all my senses are intense, and external stimuli is orgasmic
4hr: coming down great feeling I love the amp comedowns my limbs are tingling and it feels like angels massaging my skin, every now and then the tip of my finger goes numb
Sum: I created a dopamine frenzy with focalin working to produce more dopamine and the adderall just dumping it in my system very uplifted mood
